item.description:
• Dreams are sturdier: no stage can lose its database connection while it waits on a slow model.
  • The conflict queue only shows contradictions that are still open, and old verdicts retire on their own.
  • Local only can be turned on with your kit's built-in memory model, which never leaves your machine.
  • Adding a model in Settings puts it to work on any job that had no model.
  • Imports that keep failing now say so, and Retry picks them up again.
